cards.meaning: disrespectful, irreverent — insolent toward something that deserves respect (a court, parents, the sacred)
cards.example: Itinuring ng ilang senador na lapastangan sa hukuman ang mga pahayag ng tagapagsalita.
cards.exampleMeaning: Some senators considered the spokesman's statements disrespectful to the court.
cards.note: Mas mabigat kaysa 'bastos' (pang-araw-araw). May bahid ng paglabag sa institusyon o banal na bagay — kaya madalas sa sermon, korte, Senado. Pandiwa: lapastanganin / nilapastangan; gawa: kalapastanganan.
cards.tiesTo: Impeachment court orders Panelo to show cause over 'bias' remarks

cards.meaning: the side one favors; 'may kinikilingan' = biased, partial (root: kiling, a lean or tilt)
cards.example: Sinabi ng tagapagsalita na may kinikilingan ang tatlong senador-hukom.
cards.exampleMeaning: The spokesman said the three senator-judges are biased.
cards.note: Pormal, pang-legal at pamamahayag. Iba sa 'kampi' (kolokyal, pang-barkada) at 'may pinapanigan' (neutral). Kabaligtaran: 'walang kinikilingan' — pangako ng hukom at mamamahayag.
cards.tiesTo: Panelo's claim that senator-judges Tulfo, Pangilinan, Hontiveros are biased

cards.meaning: unexpectedly; to one's surprise (the outcome defies expectation)
cards.example: 收入没有增长，利润竟然涨了25%。
cards.examplePinyin: Shōurù méiyǒu zēngzhǎng, lìrùn jìngrán zhǎng le 25%.
cards.exampleMeaning: Revenue didn't grow, yet profit unexpectedly rose 25%.
cards.note: HSK 4 abstract adverb, placed before the verb/adjective. vs 居然 (more 口语, often disapproving/incredulous) and 没想到 (colloquial, clause-initial). 竟然 is more neutral and at home in written news; adds editorial surprise.

cards.meaning: to compress; (business) to squeeze / cut costs
cards.example: 拼多多压缩了营销费用，利润反而增长了。
cards.examplePinyin: Pīnduōduō yāsuō le yíngxiāo fèiyong, lìrùn fǎn'ér zēngzhǎng le.
cards.exampleMeaning: PDD squeezed its marketing spending, and profit actually rose.
cards.note: 书面语/formal. Collocates with 成本, 开支, 预算, 利润空间. vs 减少 (neutral 'reduce'), 削减 (stronger 'slash', budgets/jobs); 压缩 = tightening under pressure, not eliminating. 口语: 省钱.
cards.tiesTo: PDD Q3: sales & marketing spend −17%, operating profit +25%
